The remote_share coefficient stays small and insignificant (about -0.2 to -0.3 patents per 100 engineers, p of 0.24 to 0.40) when I add the 2020 patent baseline and all the pre-period covariates. The confidence interval (roughly -0.75 to +0.19 on an outcome mean near 100) rules out any sizeable effect, so 'no detectable effect' is supported. The only caveats are that the report omits the baseline control and that the data are cross-sectional.
